verdict.rationale: Otter documents its own event-driven automations. After meetings it automatically pushes action items to JIRA/Asana and ClickUp, syncs transcripts and summaries to Airtable and CRMs, and creates Zendesk/ServiceNow tickets; it can also be scheduled to auto-join meetings. It lists a Zapier integration and API & Webhooks, and says teams can 'trigger actions based on meeting content' via its public API. However, these are fixed integration behaviors or developer building blocks, not a user-facing rule builder. Community discussion is about privacy and doesn't address this. missing for 10: a native user-defined rule/condition builder, documentation of configurable triggers and conditions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
